sentences.text: Aftab Alam vs Mahnaz Begum on 18 August, 2023

Item No.1613 Court No.13 Section Ii-C
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings

Transfer Petition(S)(Criminal) No(S).561/2023
 Aftab Alam & Ors. Petitioner(s)
 Versus
 Mahnaz Begum Respondent(s)
 (For Admission and Ia No.158142/2023-EX-PARTE Stay and 
 No.158143/2023-EXEMPTION From Filing O.T. )
 Date : 18-08-2023
This petition was called on for hearing today.

Coram :
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice K.V. Viswanathan
For Petitioner(s) Mr. Konark Tyagi, AOR

For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

Learned counsel for the petitioners drews the attention to the fact that already on 06.05.2021 the respondent has filed an FIR bearing No.57 of 2021 against the petitioners under Section 498A, 323,
506 IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 at Police Station Tindwari, Banda.

It is submitted that the charge- sheet in the said FIR was filed on 10.06.2021 and a supplementary charge-sheet has also been filed against the petitioner no.2 on 05.03.2022 and cognizance against the accused mentioned therein have been taken on 15.04.2022.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners states that on 21.08.2021 a complaint case No.632 of 2021 have been filed against them under Section 12(1) of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 titled Mahnaz Begum vs. Aftab Alam & Ors. in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, North-East, Karkardooma Court, Delhi.
